mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, detail_address, is_default, create_time FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address ( user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, detail_address, is_default, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
